name: Green Goddess Halloumi Smash
notes:
A green goddess smash with silken tofu, avocado, feta and halloumi. There's no cut-down version of this one.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 1 hispi cabbage
• 1 cucumber
• 1 green apple
• 2 sticks celery
• 1 lemon
• 20g fresh basil
For the dressing:
• 300g silken tofu
• 1 avocado
• 20g fresh parsley
• 20g fresh coriander
• 1 lemon
• Salt

Method: not included in the source copy.

The copy this came from is incomplete: it has no method, and the feta, halloumi and "to serve" items are missing from the ingredients. Check the source for the full recipe.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 11g, fibre 5g, sugars 9g, sodium 1012mg.
